# Glossary

Working glossary entries live in `glossary/glossary.yaml` (aliases in `glossary/aliases.yaml`, acronyms in `glossary/acronym_registry.yaml`).

Book-wide canonical meanings for high-risk terms live in `book/terminology.yaml`. Use that registry to prevent contradictions; chapter prose may vary in wording.

Cross-book misconception mapping: `publication/full31/quality/MISCONCEPTION_MATRIX.md`.

Chapter “Glossary links” sections should point to defined terms rather than inventing conflicting definitions.

This appendix is a **navigation stub** for the full-book build. Do not treat an incomplete glossary as publication-ready terminology.
